collected: in the working session, in answer to direct questions
subject: Does the native Overlay core follow the spoken audio (speaking while it sounds, stops when the reply is cut) in sync?
questions_asked: Did you hear both phrases (the second cut mid-sentence)?
Did you see the Overlay core switch to speaking while it sounded and stop when it was cut?
Did you notice any lag between sound and image, or did it feel in sync?

answers.context: given right after watching the attended run (Overlay open, G435 headset): one reply played to the end and one cut mid-sentence.

limits: A single overall answer, not itemised per question. The machine measurements of the same sequence are in the av-sync-human sample, captured to file in an identical immediate re-run of the same harness (the observed run itself printed its trace to the terminal).
